findings.title: Error events are duplicated across pages and tail errors are appended to every page
findings.body: gen_request_data is called once per paginated page with the full, time-sorted error_events list, but error_idx restarts at 0 on every call. Errors that were already emitted on earlier pages are emitted again on later pages. The trailing loop at lines 164-168 also appends every error not yet yielded, including errors that occur long after the page's segments, so each page carries the entire future error tail. For any replay that spans more than one page, the Seer summarize request receives duplicated and out-of-range error lines. The new test only covers a single segment, so this is not exercised.

findings.title: Snuba query and nodestore fetch run on every page request, even when error context is disabled
findings.body: The Snuba query via query_replay_instance and the nodestore fetch in fetch_error_details now run before self.paginate on every request, so each page of segment metadata re-runs them. Error IDs are also computed before the enable_error_context flag is checked (lines 87-89), so the replay query still runs when error context is turned off and its result is then discarded.

findings.title: Error IDs are positionally zipped with a dict returned by get_multi
findings.body: zip(error_ids, events.values()) assumes get_multi returns values in the same order as error_ids and includes an entry for every ID. nodestore returns a dict keyed by node ID, which may be ordered differently or omit missing nodes. Event IDs can then be attached to another event's title/message/timestamp, and the if data is not None filter never catches a missing node. Iterate error_ids and look each node up by key instead.

findings.title: Strict report-type enum plus batch-wide 422 drops valid reports
findings.body: The type field is now a ChoiceField restricted to eight types, and any report that fails validation makes the handler return 422 for the whole array (lines 110-118). Browsers send batches and do not retry 4xx responses. One report of an unlisted type, such as the NEL network-error type or any future Reporting API type, causes every report in that batch to be discarded, and no metrics are recorded for them. Previously unknown types were processed. Consider skipping invalid entries and still returning 200, or at least not rejecting the whole batch.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table path renders hardcoded empty data instead of query results
findings.body: When organization.features includes 'use-table-widget-visualization', every table widget renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns={[]} and a literal tableData of data: [] with empty fields and units. The actual result.data and result.meta are ignored, so enabled orgs see empty tables for every table widget. This looks like a placeholder left in the production render path.

findings.title: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES is applied only when a search query is entered
findings.body: The early return at lines 61-63 returns the sorted list untouched when the search box is empty, so is_segment, project_id and received are displayed by default. The HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES exclusion is only in the filter branch below, so those attributes disappear as soon as the user types something. The exclusion should apply in both cases.

findings.title: Every generated repository token is the same hardcoded constant
findings.body: FULL_TOKEN (and the truncated form) is a fixed UUID literal marked 'HARDCODED VALUES FOR TESTING'. Generate and Regenerate always display this same value, and the UI tells users to store it as their repository secret. Users get a non-random credential that is visible in the shipped bundle, and it is presented as a freshly generated token.

findings.title: Attribute-keys query key omits the organization
findings.body: The key is ['use-trace-item-attribute-keys', queryOptions], and queryOptions contains no organization slug, although the request is org-scoped. The previous useApiQuery key included the org path. With an empty project selection (project: undefined), two organizations produce the same key, and while refetching the hook returns previous data (isFetching ? previous : data), so one org can briefly show another org's attribute keys. The retry and staleTime settings also changed from the previous hook.

findings.title: Saved-search conversion migrations gutted and pointing to a file outside this change
findings.body: Both 0917 and 0920 now just return, with a comment pointing to 0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py. That file is not in this changeset. If it does not already exist on the base branch, org saved searches are never converted to GroupSearchView rows in any environment. The 0917 data test was also deleted, so nothing verifies the conversion. The same comment appears at 0920 line 14.

findings.title: Owner is not checked for organization membership in this validator
findings.body: The new owner ActorField accepts any actor, and nothing added here checks that the owner belongs to the detector's organization. test_owner_not_in_organization in test_organization_detector_index.py expects a 400 for a user from another org. Unless ActorField enforces membership (verify), detectors can be assigned owners outside the org.

findings.title: Null max_segment_id branch in delete.py is not exercised
findings.body: The fixture changed max_segment_id to None, but delete_matched_rows is patched out, so _make_recording_filenames and its new None early return in src/sentry/replays/usecases/delete.py never run. Nothing tests that a row with max_segment_id None yields no filenames and does not raise during deletion.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before the feature gate and body validation
findings.body: analytics.record('preprod_artifact.api.assemble') runs before the features.has check and before schema validation. Requests that get a 404 (feature disabled) or 400 are still counted as assemble events, which skews adoption metrics. Move the record call after the feature check, or after successful validation.

findings.title: Default autofix tuning silently changes from low to off for all projects
findings.body: Projects that never set sentry:autofix_automation_tuning now resolve to off instead of low, and constants.py line 724 makes the same change. Existing customers lose automatic autofix with no opt-in or migration, and the PR description gives no rationale.

findings.title: Removes registration of an experiment option that may still be read
findings.body: The grouping.experiments.parameterization.traceparent option is unregistered. Any remaining options.get call with that key, including any code that builds option names from the parameterization pattern names, will raise for an unknown option. Confirm there are no remaining readers.

findings.title: Unescaped issue title and environment inside PR comment markdown
findings.body: The title is placed in the link label [**{title}**] and the environment in backticks, with no escaping. Titles containing ], newlines or markdown break the link or bullet structure of the posted comment. Titles are derived from user event data. Previously the title was outside a link, so the new wrapper makes ] a real breakage case. Sanitize newlines and brackets.

findings.title: Per-issue event load during comment build, with broad exception swallowing
findings.body: get_environment_info calls issue.get_recommended_event() for each of the top issues while building the PR comment, which loads an event from nodestore each time. The surrounding except Exception logs at info and returns an empty string, so real failures such as nodestore errors are effectively invisible. Narrow the exception and log at warning or above.

findings.title: DB query injection detector now suppressed until five occurrences
findings.body: NoiseConfig(ignore_limit=5) delays reporting of DBQueryInjectionVulnerability issues until five occurrences are seen. This is a security-relevant detector and the PR gives no rationale for the trade-off. Confirm the intent.

findings.title: Typo 'the the' in story copy
findings.body: The introductory paragraph reads 'Below is the the most basic example'. The duplicated word should be removed.
